items.lang|foxablazeaqzl_wiki|foxablazeaqzl_wi: No English wiki description is available for this skill.

Possess a weakened material body to gain access to a whole new world.

Active
[Active - Press] - If used while possessing a body, leaves the body (which will despawn in 5 minutes to avoid lag unless its the original body) and its intrinsic skills behind and turns the player into Spiritual Form. While in spiritual form if the player can possess a target: [Ineffective against target with Spiritual Nullification toggled]
Non-player mob: At below 10% HP, Below 10% Spiritual HP, or below 25% Maximum EP (Relative to the user) - Reduce to 5% HP, 5% SHP or 12.5% EP if the target has Spiritual Attack Resistance toggled.
Player: Require 2 out of the 3 optional requirements above. If possessed, the target player will be put into Spiritual form and will die eventually without having [Possession].
Active: When possessing a target, the user turns back into Physical Form with the target’s physical stats and it's skills.
WARNING:
Upon usage of this skill, hand slot items and armor will be left behind on the old body.
Friendly reminder to acces the inventory and take these items from your old body back.

See through falsehoods and invisibility, conceal your presence from prying eyes and create illusions.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] Makes the player able to see through illusions and invisible targets
Active
[Active - Press] Presence Concealment: When activated, makes mobs unable to register the player for 120 seconds. Costs 200 MP.
Active: [Active - Press] Illusion: When activated, open a GUI that enables the player to choose any fake item to wear on each armor and hand slot.
Active: [Active - Hold] Fake Death: When held down, reduce the speed by 40% (20% with Mastery). While this mode is held down (maximum hold time is 30 seconds), if the user takes any type of damage, spawn a new body then instant kill it with the same type of damage and send a fake death message to every player online. At the same time, reduce the incoming damage by half for the user and put the user into Presence Concealment, and stay in concealment till release or max hold time is reached - 10s cooldown (5s with Mastery)

The one who lurks in the shadows... Just waiting for things to happen. The one who answers your questions at every call...

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] Silence Between Two Strikes - All player sounds are muted.
Passive: [Passive - Toggle] Hidden Authority - Go invisible and conceal your presence to those around. On servers, hide yourself from the tab list as well and fake a leaving message. Untoggling will play a fake joining message.
Passive: [Passive - True] Ruler's Reign - All nearby subordinates gain Inspiration 1. On mastery, this changes to Inspiration 2.
Active
[Active - Press] Copy - Fetch the skill list of your target. Copy one random skill (Intrinsics, Commons or Extras) at random from the learned skills of your target. Copied skills are temporary and are lost on death. Copied skills last for as long as the user holds on to them or dies with it. You can only copy up to five temporary skills, where your cap will then be full. Shift + Skill Key to display all currently copied skills. 25% success rate. 75% failure rate. Changes to 50-50 on mastery.
Active: [Active - Press] Paste - Paste one of your five copied skills at random to your target. The target need not be a subordinate. The target will keep the skill until they die. Again, shift + skill key to display all currently copied skills in the list. 25% success rate. 75% failure rate. Changes to 50-50 on mastery. On failure, the copied skill is lost.
Active: [Active - Press] Recruitment - Recruit the target as a temporary subordinate (Charm) if they are weaker than you by 5x. Costs 1000 MP. Fails if the target is a boss.

Use magicules to strengthen your muscles.

Active
[Active - Press] - Grants the user Strengthen for 60 seconds and costs 30 MP. With Mastery, Increase to Strengthen II, lasts 120 seconds, and becomes toggleable but will only grant Strengthen this way.
This skill gains mastery passively while its actived, and can be pressed again to deactivate it

Take everything. Conquer the world and your enemies with it. Kill anyone who stands in your path while strengthening yourself or your allies.

Active
[Active - Hold] Spiritual Domination: When held down and looking at a mob, put it under control after a certain amount of time passes. Base Value = 60 seconds. Being in a distance of 5 blocks decreases base value by 30 seconds and being at a distance over 20 blocks increases the value by 30 seconds [Max distance is 30 blocks]. When used against a mob rather than a player, it increases value by another 30 seconds. When used against players, it decreases the time by 1 second per 1 desire value. 1 desire value = 10 villager trades. Control time decreased by 2 seconds for each trade a trader mob has. [You must be looking at the target for the whole time or the timer will go down; Shift activate can release/free the controlled target]
Active: [Active - Toggle] Greed Flare: Must be sneaking to deactivate
If used while looking at nothing, grants the player a buff that increases the damage of their physical attacks equal to 5% (10% with mastery) of their current spiritual hp, 20s (10s with mastery) cooldown. [Activate again to turn off, consume 10 mp * boosted damage each attack]
If used while looking at an ally within 20 blocks, grant the buff to them instead, equal to 2.5% (5% with mastery) of that ally’s current SHP, 20s (10s with mastery) cooldown. [Consume 50 mp * damage on activation]
If used while looking at a mob within 20 blocks, deals damage to that mob equal to the 2.5% (5% with mastery) of the user’s current SHP, 20s (10s with mastery) cooldown. [Consume 20 mp * boosted damage each attack]
Active: [Active - Hold] Death Wish: If held down for 200 ticks while looking at a mob within 5 blocks, instantly kills them. Slows target by 60%. Costs 1000 MP [You must be looking at the target for the whole time or the timer will go down]

Slice through reality and manifest spatial blades which cut through armor and unleash devastating blade storms.

Active
[Active - Press] - Dummy Sword: At the cost of 100 MP, creates a Spatial Blade (with Severance V - X with mastery) in an empty hand slot. Blades infinitely regenerate at the cost of 20 MP per blade.
Active: [Active - Press] - Blade Storm: Require Spatial Blade to be in 1 of the user’s hand. At the cost of 2000 MP, unleashes 5 (10 with mastery) Severance Blades from behind the user to looked-at target (max range 20 blocks - 30 with Mastery). Cooldown 5s (3s with mastery).
Active: [Active - Press] - Severance: Applies a severance effect and a 10 (30 with Mastery) damage boost to the player's attacks for 120 seconds. Costs 200 MP.

Your curiosity drives you to seek the truths of this world and learn as much as possible about it

Law Manipulation is acquired upon obtaining Seeker. If Seeker is created with Creator, Law Manipulation will not be obtained.
Passive
Increases the amount of Learned Points and Mastery Points gained for Magics by 4.
Passive: Thought Acceleration (Like Normal)
Passive: Chant Annulment (Like Normal)
Active
[ Active - Press] - Analyze: When held down for 3s (1s with mastery) (affected by Chanting Speed) while looking at a Magic Circle or Magic Entity (barrier, field, projectile, etc.) within 15 blocks radius, copies the magic. It can't copy any spirit magic or elemental summoning magic

"A husk of what you formally were. The leftovers, discarded without a second thought when the split happened. Coldness seeps through your skin as you freeze everything to reclaim your other parts."

Passive
[Passive, In Slot] Pressure:
You emit a pressure when hit by a player, that player’s cost for abilities are double for 30 seconds.
Active
[Active, Hold] Glaciate - Cost 500 MP per second you hold it. You surround yourself and the air with hail, slowing down everything in a 10 block radius, and dealing increasing cold damage, starting at 10, and going up by 5 every 10 seconds, stopping at 100 damage. Slows down the users as well, Like Demon Lord Haki and other such skills. CD 30 Seconds. When Mastered, Damage Cap is raised to 200.
Active: [Active, Press] Draconic Pulse - Cost 300 MP to fire. You launch a blast of draconic energy in the shape of a dragon from your mouth leaving destruction in its wake, if hit by the draconic energy it deals 40 Magic Damage. CD is 10 Seconds, lowered to 5 seconds when mastered.
Active: [Active, Hold] Freeze Dry - Costs 500 MP per second while holding it. When looking at a mob or player, you rapidly freeze the air around them, dealing 20 cold damage every second for as long as you hold and look at them. It also slows them down a bit, with a small chance of leaving them frozen in place, 10% chance for 30 seconds. Cold Resistance makes it 5% and 15 seconds. Cold Nullification ignores the chance. 20 Second CD, lowered to 10 seconds when mastered.
Active: [Active, Hold] Blizzard:
Summon a storm of ice, pelting targets with heavy cold and water damage. Lasts until released, and goes on a 10 second cooldown after.

Shoot a fiery projectile or summon a short-ranged fire storm which will damage all nearby entities

Active
[Active - Press] - Projectile: At the cost of 40 MP, launch a projectile where the player is looking. The projectile does 30 damage on contact and does 10 damage every second to everything in a 5x5 radius around it while in motion. 3 second cooldown(1 second with mastery)
Active: [Active - Hold] - Storm: At the cost of 20 MP per second, all mobs around the player in a 10x10 Radius take 10 damage every second.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] When toggled on, outlines entities flagged "warm blooded" and blocks that emit heat with a red outline in a 20 block Radius. When mastered, block outlines can be toggled off by activating the skill. Entities flagged Cold-blooded don't appear at all, and entities flagged Cold Source like Snow Golem will have cyan outline. Doesn't work in the nether.

Turn the world into a weapon, absorb the environment to create powerful mines and grenades.

Active
[Active - Press] Disassemble: Breaks the block the player is looking at, but instead of dropping the block it adds 1 "Matter". Shift activate to consume the block items in hand instead.
Active: [Active - Press] Fuse: Turns the block the player is looking at into a "landmine" at the cost of 5 Matters. When its touched by an unallied player/mob or when the skill button is pressed again, creates a TR Explosion the size of 25 blocks, dealing 300(500 with mastery) damage instantly. Costs 1000 MP.
When Fusionist is mastered, Fuse can be charged again by activating the mode again while looking at the mine at close range. Each charge increases dmg by 50 and radius by 5, costing 10 matter per charge with a maximum of 5 charges.
Active: [Active - Press] Stone: At the cost of 1 Matter, throws a projectile that explodes on contact and deals 100 damage. Explosion level 6, damage around 77. Costs 200 MP. Can deal the same damage even to enemies hiding behind blocks.
